name: KG Dongbu Steel Co.,Ltd.
summary: KG Dongbu Steel Co., Ltd. operates as a global producer and distributor of various steel goods, with its business reaching across South Korea and international markets. The company's diverse portfolio features cold-rolled steel, pre-coated sheets, galvanized iron, and prefabricated building components. They also supply tin plates, H-beams, spiral pipes, and specialized steel pipe piling, including sheet piles. Their products are primarily utilized by the automotive, domestic appliance, and construction industries. Established in 1967, the enterprise maintains its corporate headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
